@_dw_functools.wraps(_dw_orig_tls_init)
def _dw_tls_init(self, client_cert=None, ca_cert=None, verify=None,
                 ssl_version=None, assert_hostname=None, assert_fingerprint=None):
    for _n, _v in (('ssl_version', ssl_version), ('assert_hostname', assert_hostname),
                   ('assert_fingerprint', assert_fingerprint)):
        if _v is not None:
            _dw_warnings.warn(
                'TLSConfig(%s=...) is deprecated and ignored by docker 7; '
                'the value is kept only as an attribute.' % _n,
                DeprecationWarning, stacklevel=2)
    _dw_orig_tls_init(self, client_cert=client_cert, ca_cert=ca_cert, verify=verify)
    self.ssl_version = ssl_version
    self.assert_hostname = assert_hostname
    self.assert_fingerprint = assert_fingerprint

_dw_tls.TLSConfig.__init__ = _dw_tls_init

@_dw_functools.wraps(_dw_orig_kfe)
def _dw_kwargs_from_env(*args, ssl_version=None, assert_hostname=None, environment=None):

        _dw_warnings.warn('Positional arguments to kwargs_from_env are deprecated; '
                          'use environment=...', DeprecationWarning, stacklevel=2)
        _names = ['ssl_version', 'assert_hostname', 'environment']
        _vals = dict(zip(_names, args))
        ssl_version = _vals.get('ssl_version', ssl_version)
        assert_hostname = _vals.get('assert_hostname', assert_hostname)
        environment = _vals.get('environment', environment)
    if ssl_version is not None or assert_hostname is not None:
        _dw_warnings.warn('kwargs_from_env(ssl_version=..., assert_hostname=...) is '
                          'deprecated and ignored by docker 7.', DeprecationWarning, stacklevel=2)
    params = _dw_orig_kfe(environment=environment)
    _t = params.get('tls')
    if _t is not None and not isinstance(_t, bool):
        _t.ssl_version = ssl_version
        _t.assert_hostname = assert_hostname
    return params

_dw_uu.kwargs_from_env = _dw_kwargs_from_env
_dw_utils.kwargs_from_env = _dw_kwargs_from_env
